title: Signal: Event data in a workflow expression via run: echo "${{ github.event.issue.title }}" (github-actions) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on an event-data expression in github-actions workflow files.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: matches the expression wherever it appears, including non-shell inputs such as env: values, which are the safe pattern.
fpNotes: An expression assigned into env: (rather than a run: body) is the safe usage and the common accepted case.
